name: video-downloads-transcription
title: Video Downloads & Transcription
description: Download audio and video from YouTube, Instagram, X and hundreds of sites, save subtitles, and dictate or transcribe locally with whisper.cpp
author: davidrosic

commands.name: download-video
commands.title: Download Video
commands.subtitle: Subtitles, audio & video
commands.description: Download subtitles in any language from a YouTube video, playlist or channel, or audio and video from YouTube, Instagram, X and other sites

commands.name: transcribe-selected-files
commands.title: Transcribe Selected Files
commands.subtitle: Finder · whisper.cpp
commands.description: Transcribe or translate the audio and video files or folders selected in Finder with whisper.cpp

commands.name: dictate
commands.title: Dictate
commands.subtitle: Local whisper.cpp · hold to talk
commands.description: Hold its Raycast hotkey to dictate locally, then release to insert the text at the cursor

commands.name: configure-dictation
commands.title: Configure Dictation
commands.subtitle: Voice & bubble settings
commands.description: Choose the separate whisper model, microphone, language and bubble position used for local dictation

commands.name: transcription-queue
commands.title: Queue
commands.subtitle: Downloads & transcriptions
commands.description: See running, queued and finished downloads and transcriptions, cancel them, and open the results. The queue keeps running when you close Raycast.

commands.name: manage-tools-and-models
commands.title: Manage Tools and Models
commands.subtitle: yt-dlp, ffmpeg, whisper.cpp
commands.description: Install yt-dlp, ffmpeg and whisper.cpp with Homebrew, download whisper models and their Core ML encoders, and choose the default model

commands.name: queue-menu-bar
commands.title: Queue in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Progress while jobs run
commands.description: Shows download and transcription progress in the menu bar while the queue is running

preferences.name: downloadDirectory
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Where subtitles, audio, video and YouTube transcriptions are saved

preferences.name: ytDlpPath
preferences.title: yt-dlp Executable
preferences.description: Optional; otherwise found in PATH or common Homebrew locations

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Executable
preferences.description: Needed for MP3, M4A and MP4, subtitle conversion, and transcription

preferences.name: browserCookies
preferences.title: Browser Sign-In
preferences.description: Off by default. Choose Firefox or Safari to download videos and posts that need an account. yt-dlp reads cookies locally and sends the cookies needed to the site you're downloading from.

preferences.name: browserTab
preferences.title: Browser Tab
preferences.label: Load the video open in your browser
preferences.description: When no video link is in your clipboard, Download Video opens the video in the browser tab you were watching. macOS asks once to let Raycast read the tab's address.

preferences.name: whisperPath
preferences.title: whisper.cpp CLI
preferences.description: Path to whisper-cli; auto-detected in ~/GitHub/whisper.cpp when available

preferences.name: modelPath
preferences.title: Default Whisper Model
preferences.description: Optional; a ggml model such as ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin. When not set, the default chosen in Manage Tools and Models is used. Other models in the same folder can be chosen when transcribing.

preferences.name: skipSilence
preferences.title: Voice Activity Detection
preferences.label: Skip silence with Silero VAD
preferences.description: Transcribe only the parts with speech. This stops whisper from inventing text during silence and music, and is faster.

preferences.name: vadModelPath
preferences.title: Silero VAD Model
preferences.description: Optional; ggml-silero-v6.2.0.bin (885 KB) is downloaded automatically when not set

preferences.name: notifyWhenDone
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Notify when the queue finishes
preferences.description: Show a macOS notification when everything in the queue is done

preferences.name: whisperLanguage
preferences.title: Transcription Language
preferences.description: Spoken language to preselect when no favorite language matches, for example Serbian or auto

preferences.name: favoriteLanguages
preferences.title: Favorite Caption Languages
preferences.description: Comma-separated language names or codes; case and '(orig)' are ignored (for example Serbian, English)
